events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up where guests can browse Calzedonia legwear, refresh hair and makeup, use a photo booth, and stop between shows.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, branded stickers, coffee, hairstyle touchups, skincare sampling/touchups, and the photo booth are advertised as free. Embroidery is free only with purchase of eligible 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Current public-event listings agree that the pop-up is open to the public. Free embroidery requires purchase of the eligible knee highs, and samples or promotional items can be inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, September 12–13, from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.address: Flatiron Plaza, 23rd Street and Broadway, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: A two-day outdoor launch pop-up for OLAPLEX Shape Set hairspray with a photo activation, product sampling, and branded merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Shape Set samples and OLAPLEX merch are advertised. The first 50 attendees each day can receive a full-size 245 ml Shape Set Hairspray while supplies last.
events.caveats: The full-size hairspray offer is limited to the first 50 attendees each day and is while supplies last. Other samples and merch are also inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, September 12–13, from 11 AM–5 PM at Flatiron Plaza. Current listings describe the event as free and open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement.

events.address: Stephan Weiss Studio, 711 Greenwich St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A two-day fragrance pop-up celebrating Estée Lauder Glimmer Eau de Parfum with scent discovery, street treats, and promotional gifts.
events.what_is_free: Public entry plus advertised street treats and promotional gifts. Exact gift quantities and contents are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current listings describe the activation as open to the public. Gifts and treats may be limited by available inventory.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 12:30–7 PM and Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–7 PM at 711 Greenwich Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified listings.
